function_v0.doc: `[id_this, id_market(this, data), id_market(this, xdr(HubAssetKey))]` (Q129). Accepts\nthe market the first time.
function_v0.name: ids

function_v0.doc:
Anyone: extends `vault`'s XOXNO account in the market named by `data` (the strategy
owns it, so it may call XOXNO's `renew_account`) and the strategy's own entries for
it. XOXNO extends an account's storage only when it is touched. Moves no money; a
vault without an account there is left as it is.
function_v0.name: renew

function_v0.doc: The XOXNO account `vault` holds in the market named by `data`; 0 for none.
function_v0.name: account

function_v0.doc: Keeper only. XOXNO pays suppliers no reward on Stellar (Q130), so this claims nothing;\nit emits `Harvest` so the trait is the same as for strategies that do. `data` is\nignored.
function_v0.name: harvest

function_v0.doc:
Supplies `assets`, pulled from the vault, to the vault's own XOXNO account in the
market named by `data`, opening one when the vault has none (or XOXNO says the one
recorded is gone). `change` is the position's value now minus the value last recorded.
Any refusal by XOXNO (its global pause, a paused or frozen listing, a full supply cap,
...) is `ProtocolRejected`, and the core vault keeps the deposit idle (revised Q59).
The protocol total grows by `assets` (Q89), less what the position's principal stood
above its value (Q90).
function_v0.name: allocate

function_v0.doc:
Withdraws `assets` from the vault's XOXNO account in the market named by `data` and
sends exactly that to the vault. The whole value is a full exit: XOXNO burns every
share and pays their floor value, the value, and the vault's record of the account is
cleared (XOXNO's adapter, fix `6995a33`). A paused listing, short cash, the utilization
ceiling and an insolvent pool are `InsufficientLiquidity`, and nothing moves. Never
gated by approval or the protocol cap. The protocol total loses the principal taken
out (Q89), and whatever of the rest stands above the position's value (Q90).
function_v0.name: deallocate

function_v0.doc: Value of every position of `vault`: its account's shares at the supply index accrued to\nnow, `floor(floor(shares \xc3\x97 index / RAY) / 10^(27\xe2\x88\x92d))`; the value last recorded for a\nmarket that cannot be read. Never fails and never writes.
function_v0.name: real_assets

function_v0.doc:
One instance per asset and XOXNO controller. `factory` decides which vaults may
allocate; `cap_authority` alone sets the protocol cap; `keeper` alone may call
`harvest`. The pool's address is read from `controller`, and the asset's decimals from
the token, once. All fixed: there is no admin (rule 10).
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Anyone: lowers `vault`'s principal in the market named by `data`, and the protocol
total by the same amount, to the position's value when that is lower, and emits
`PrincipalSynced` (its `market` is the controller; the market itself is in no event).
Never raises it, moves no money and reports no `change`. A position that does not
exist, or a market that cannot be read, is left as it is (Q90).
function_v0.name: sync_position

function_v0.doc:
What `deallocate(vault, data, x)` can pay in this ledger: the smallest of the
position's value, the pool's cash and, below a 100% ceiling with debt in the market,
what keeps utilization within `max_utilization` after the exit. 0 while the spoke's
listing is paused, on malformed `data` or on any failed read (Q128). Never writes.
function_v0.name: max_deallocate

function_v0.doc: Sum of the principal every vault has put in and not taken out (Q89).
function_v0.name: total_allocated

function_v0.doc: Cap authority only. 0 removes the cap.
function_v0.name: set_protocol_cap
